Minions: the venom golem's 7.5% more damage taken now counts for minion hits and poison on real monsters (checked in game logs; the Training Post does not show it).
Minions: Choir of Bones' 12% more damage for projectile minions (Skeletal Mage) and Boundless Mind's 15% less minion damage now count.
Sparks and Winter Orb: cast speed now speeds up their strikes the way the game does (Sparks about 8 to 20% more damage, Winter Orb icicles about 25 to 75% more).
Save Creator: copying a build now copies its sworn Oaths too.
Passive tree: a note and a pulsing diamond show Oath seats you have opened but not sworn an Oath at.
New Support via Ko-fi button (card or PayPal) beside Buy me a coffee.
The whole site is faster: damage numbers calculate about twice as fast, the passive tree and Item Simulator no longer recalculate when nothing changed, and pages load quicker.
Build Planner: clicks and edits respond about twice as fast. Each change no longer re-checks every skill in the list.
Saved Builds now lists only builds you saved yourself. Builds opened from a share link or a code go to their own list below, "Opened, not saved", with a Save button to move one up.
Save as new build under a name you already used saves over that build, so a character you load again updates the same build.
Rune sockets open a searchable list: hover a rune or jewel to see what it gives in a weapon and in armour.

New: an EHP (est.) number in the summary strip next to the resistances. Hover it for the biggest single hit you survive of each damage type (Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison) and what a 5,000 hit deals to you.
It is an estimate from life, energy shield, armour and resistances; glancing blows are not counted.
Enemy setup: the Consecrated Ground box is now "Hallowed ground", ticked by default when your skills or Dragonling nodes make it (Hallowed Verdict, Sanctuary, Consecrated Bulwark).
Consecrated Ground not on your skill bar has its own tick; before, the box always counted its 20%, even for builds whose own ground gives 10%.
Great and Flawless Rares now boost their lines by 7.5% and 22% (was 10% and 30%), the numbers the game uses since Patch 83.
Minions: at most 28 stand at once (was 40), and every one of them counts in full.
Bonus points: the limit is now 24. The five Inscribed Quartz at Rupture Level 86, 89, 92, 95 and 98 are counted, in the Save Creator too.
Build Planner: the mouse wheel changes Level and Bonus points while the pointer is over the box, and a note shows when bonus points are more than the patch gives.
Icons for the 17 new unique items and Herald of Steel.

Skill tree: you can now take more points than a level 100 character has. The counter shows points taken / the most you can have and turns red when you are over, with a note at the top saying how many to refund.
Skill tree: the character's level now rises with the points you take (and comes back down when you refund, never below its own level).
Plans: change class, level and bonus points right on the Character tab. A class change keeps the passive tree and links it to the new start.
New Saved Builds tab: every build you saved, with search, Open, Duplicate and Delete. The Character list on the left now shows only loaded characters (and the build you have open).
Middle-click or Ctrl+click a tab to open it in a new browser tab.
Item window: Quality box (up to 30%) and a Truesworn box (Base Grade 90+). Armour quality now counts: it adds to the piece's own increased defences, as the game's tooltip shows.
Vows (not Heralds) now offer only the supports the game lets in: Cast when Hit, Economical Vow and Fervent Vow.
A red item's Vows can come from any rare of the same slot (shield and tome lines on a quiver), as the Cube recipe says.
Changing a plan's class keeps the passive tree and links it to the new class's start. New plans start with all 19 bonus points.
Save Creator: a Deep-Forged Band or Torc holds one more Dwarven Rune.
Patch 83: your hits now count at 80% (the game's own rule since patch 82: every hit on a monster x0.8, minions, totems, traps and ailments included). Expect lower numbers everywhere.
Patch 83: gem levels from gear past +5 add less (attacks 1% a level, spells 10%, 7%, 4%, then 2%, minions 9%, 6%, 3%, then 1%). Builds with many gear levels drop the most.

Patch 83: Mage spells deal 15% more at gem level 20, up to 45% at 24; Skeletons and Skeletal Mages 20% more; Drain Life and Death Coil 15% less, Grave Golem 18% less, Venom Spark 10% less, Caustic Arrow 7% less.
Patch 83: new support Unravel counted (up to 17.5% more damage taken of the spell's element). Thousandfold gives +1 Spell Repeat. Afterimages past 3 add 10% each. At most 10 traps stand at once.

Patch 83: red item lines follow the game's new table (Hoarfall, Cinderknuckle, The Slow Verdict, Hollowhorn lower; +skill level lines no longer x1.5), and old rolls move into the new ranges as in the game.
Orbiting Hammers warns when a non-Paladin holds no mace or hammer (it does not work in the game then).
Item window: the Add Vow lists (and the Oathsworn and Scarred line lists) now have a search box. Type part of a line, then click it or press Enter.
Item window: the mouse wheel over a number box moves its value up or down, stopping at the top and bottom of the roll range.
Item window: changing a value no longer scrolls the window back to the top.
Moving a Vow with the arrows or by dragging no longer throws the page back to the top: the Vow stays where it was on screen.
Cinderwick (Primal): its third line now scales x1.8 instead of x3, matching the game's own table from today's patch.
Vows on red items can be reordered: drag a Vow by its grip, or use the up and down arrows. The 1st Vow counts in full and each later one less, so the order changes the numbers.

Rider of the Gale's Windburst is now in the sim: every 3rd movement skill bursts for 200% of your last Bow hit as Physical damage (checked in game logs). Set how many movement skills you use a second on the Damage tab to count it.

Consecrated Ground is now always in the enemy's curse list. Ticked, it counts even when it is not on your skill bar (half for classes other than Paladin), and only your strongest hallowed ground counts, on top of your curses.

Save Creator: new Riven Tier unlock under the Rupture Level. Ticking it sets the Rupture Level to 200 and opens a box for the Riven Tier to unlock; Riven points come with the tiers (one at tier 5, 10 and 15, then one every 25).
Support gems: Kindling now counts against Guardians (every 4% of the Guardian's life your spell deals counts as a kill: about 0 to 2% more damage on most builds).
Repeat on channelled skills (Cyclone, Storm Whirl, Drain Life) now adds its extra strike; before, only its less damage counted.
Chain Detonation: traps set off in a chain now deal 8% more for each trap down the chain. Rallying Standard raises the War Banner's Valour cap to 30.
War Banner: maximum Valour from the passive tree, Oaths and uniques, and increased War Banner effect, now count. Melee Splash, Ruinous Herald and Spreading Pyre are marked as pack-only supports.

Ladder: new Gem used filter: find heroes using a skill or support anywhere in their build (Trap, Spell Totem, Jarl's Roar...), not just as main skill. Covers the top 50 of each class (published builds).
Ladder: the Skill filter is now called Main skill. In a hero's build, skills not on the hotbar are greyed out and listed last.
Ladder: the Rupture Level spread and Ascendancies boxes are gone from the Meta panel.
Ladder: a slow or failed answer now shows an error instead of loading forever; changing a filter tries again.

A shock from another skill on your bar now counts for all your skills: for example a Cast on Crit Lightning Arrow shocking the enemy raises your main skill's damage, and the tree optimizer sees it (game logs). Each such skill is listed under Vows, Heralds & charges, where you can untick it.
Translations: the Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot options, gear level presets, the New first sort in Item Search and a few other new lines are now in all page languages.
Item Search: the Forged copy lines of uniques show the Ã—1.1 / Ã—1.35 tag properly again (raw page code showed instead).

Woe of Withering on a Guardian now counts at its biggest line (the Poison one) for all your damage, inside the "only the strongest" choice; its two lines no longer add, and with Death Sentence on it adds nothing (game logs).
Unique items: a new Base choice puts the unique on a Core Touched base of its kind (the cube's Vowbinding: the Mark). Its lines and Vows stay, and the base's Mark counts as its implicit.

Weapons now show Weapon DPS and Average hit: in the Character tab's item window, on weapon cards when picking an item (uniques at mid rolls), in Item Search and in the item tooltip. Average hit leaves out attack speed, for skills like Ballista.

Unique items: the game's latest scaling table is in (121 lines on 57 uniques). Six new uniques are covered, among them The Thousand Sparks and primal Kingbreaker, Gravesong, Gravecleaver, Stormfang and Rimecrown Staff; Cinderwick (primal) lines changed.

Bina's Spotter's Helm (Patch 81): the crit volley now comes every 2 seconds instead of 3, and Ballista or totem shots in a row at the same rare or Guardian deal up to 50% more (2% per shot). From the patch notes; switches on with the game's build 81 data.
Item Search: "New this patch first" is now a purple New first button next to All. It puts this patch's items on top while keeping your category, filters and sort for the rest.
Item editor: picking a different unique no longer keeps the old item's Vows when the new base can't roll them (a quiver kept a shield's Vows). A Vow its base can't roll is now marked in red.
Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot: a new Basic items only box skips Core Touched and Ashen bases (on for Midgame). The options now sit next to the gear level.
Gear Set Sim: with the Defence slider or max resistances on, a new column shows each slot's DPS change, apart from the score.

Gear Set Sim, Sim by Slot and Item Compare now check Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence requirements: the searches only suggest items you can put on, and Item Compare says when the new item needs more than you have. Tick Ignore attribute requirements for the old behaviour.
Damage: Patch 80 rules. Viper Fang deals about 29% less at high gem levels, and the Sleepy's Continental Strap poison burst now uses up the poisons still to come instead of adding damage.
Oathword items now show the runes they are made of next to the name, for example Bladesong (Tyr + Reid + Dagaz + Perthro), in the Item Simulator and in the item tooltip.

Support Gem Simulator: on translated pages the search results now show support names in your language (they stayed English when two or more were listed), and the rest of that window is translated too.
Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot: a new Gear level choice (Midgame, Endgame, BiS or Custom) sets how good and how rare the items tried are.

FAQ: new Forge & Crafting, Cube, Vows & Runes and Attributes sections. Lightless Anneal reaches the best tier only from Rupture 160; Gloomsilver crafts, Forge levels, Vow costs and rune rules are explained.
Life Leech: the "more damage while leeching" bonus now counts for 40% of the fight by default instead of all of it. Change "Time spent leeching" in the enemy settings to sim more or less.

Executioner: each skill on the bar has a "Sim executioner in this slot" box. By default it counts for the skill that has it socketed; the main skill counts the fight average, a side skill counts as a finisher on enemies below the threshold.
Build code: the page now says that a code has no rolled stats, so rare and magic items load as bare bases. Load a save, planner link or share link to keep them.
Report a problem: an optional Discord username field, so a reply can reach you.

Unique items: the game scales more red lines than we knew (51 uniques now). Mouth of the Mire, Wyrmblade of the Black Oath, Gravecleaver, Tidebreaker Maul, Cinderwick and many more now show and count the numbers the game shows.
Focused Volley now works on a Ballista (and Arrow Totem): all its bolts hit the target, each 60% of the one before, as the game log shows.
Ballista and other skills: supports granted by the tree or gear (like Tether from Killing Field) now count as links, so the patch 79 damage cut is no longer overstated.
Oaths: a seat in the passive tree costs no point now and opens with the notable beside it, as in the latest patch. Your sworn Oaths count again, and a seat you took gives its point back.

Item Search, Item mods: a new Weight column shows how likely each line and tier is to roll on its base (from the game's weights; hover the header for how it is worked out). The Roll column is now called Range.
Defences that count: a new Life box. Untick it for an energy shield build: the tree and gear searches then stop picking nodes for their life lines.
Translations: the newest page text (action bar, Fortified, Afterimages, poison breakdown, Brewery best potions, Grail signature runes, Ladder charts) in all 10 languages.
New game icons: the 7 Oath skills and Sentence of Exposure, Girdle of the Turning Earth and The Heartwood Girdle; Wool Shoes and Chapel Shoes have their icon again.
Woeweaver now also raises the skill's bleeds (game log). Woe of Sundering no longer raises bleeds in the sim: the log showed it does not.

Skill tree: right-click a taken node to keep it, so Optimize tree never refunds it. Right-click an untaken node twice to mark it must take: Optimize and Plan route to it first. On a phone, use the Keep button in the node panel.
